meta.description: CUDA Toolkit runtime version vs the minimum NVIDIA driver version that supports it (Windows / Linux). Values are the GA 'corresponding driver version' rows of the official NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit release notes; the 'note' field records where a row is a derived value (e.g. a shared driver branch) so it stays auditable. Fix or extend this data file rather than the code when NVIDIA updates the table.

entries.note: 12.7 与 12.8 同属 R570 驱动分支，GA 最低驱动与 12.8 GA 一致（官方表只列到 12.8 GA）
13.x 次版本兼容下限为驱动 ≥ 580（官方 minor version compatibility 表）；CUDA 13.0 GA 的 Linux 驱动为 580.65.06
